## Why it matters

EuroDocs curates links to open access primary sources for European history, arranged by country, supranational themes, and broad chronological periods.

It is valuable as a discovery layer when you need to move quickly across institutions and languages to locate transcriptions, facsimiles, translations, and related materials.
